[LADP.5.1] Discovery-driven adapters often encounter attributes whose
runtime type varies across entities of the same domain. Home
Assistant's `state` attribute is the canonical case —
numeric on `sensor.temp`, string on `light.foo`, boolean-ish
string (`"on"`/`"off"`) on `binary_sensor.door`. A Matter
adapter sees similar variation across device clusters; a
Zigbee adapter sees it across device attributes.
